events.title: Nightmare Carnival: Additional Aether Distribution
events.description: You can obtain an additional 40 Aether when using [Ark City] - [Garden Cafe] - [Store].

events.title: Virtual Tactical Simulation: Tiphera
events.description: During the Rate-Up period for Combatants [Rossweisse] and [Tiphera], you can experience Combatants [Rossweisse] and [Tiphera] through the Virtual Tactical Simulation event. You can play the trial stage using fixed Save Data that includes the trial Combatants.

events.title: 1st Anniversary Surprise Growth Support Gift Has Arrived!
events.description: Hello, this is the Chaos Zero Nightmare Team To celebrate our 1st anniversary, we've prepared a surprise gift for all of you, Protos! 🎁

events.title: Nightmare Carnival: Visit Present
events.description: Simply logging in will grant generous rewards, including a ★5 Combatant Selection Ticket and ★5 Partner Selection Ticket.

events.title: Virtual Tactical Simulation: Rossweisse
events.description: During the Rate-Up period for Combatants [Rossweisse] and [Tiphera], you can experience Combatants [Rossweisse] and [Tiphera] through the Virtual Tactical Simulation event. You can play the trial stage using fixed Save Data that includes the trial Combatants.

events.title: Nightmare Carnival: Attendance Check
events.description: Log in every day for 14 days to receive daily rewards. An Attendance Make-Up feature is also available for Captains who missed some days.

events.title: Nightmare Carnival: 70 Free Normal Rescues Distribution
events.description: During the Event period, logging in each day grants 10 free Rescues per day for 7 days, for a total of up to 70 free Rescues. Unused free Rescue attempts after logging in will carry over and can be used the next day. Accumulated free Rescues can only be used during the Event period.

events.title: Nightmare Carnival
events.description: Celebrate the 1st Anniversary with a grand event! The [Nightmare Carnival] will be held.

events.title: New Seasonal Combatant - [Rossweisse] Trauma Code Event [Blade Poised Against the Cycle]
events.description: A limited-time Trauma Code event for the new seasonal Combatant [Rossweisse] will be held. During the event period, you can obtain limited-time rewards by participating in event battles. You can experience Rossweisse's story through the Trauma Code.

events.title: [Nightmare Carnival] Special Unigram Message
events.description: Receive a small present prepared by Renoa, to celebrate the Nightmare Carnival.

events.title: Nightmare Dream Park
events.description: To celebrate the Nightmare Carnival, the [Nightmare Dream Park] event, where you build a theme park on the SS Nightmare, will be held.
